about: The confirmed look book (docs/LOOKBOOK.md, tools/lookbook.py): every look and behaviour the maintainer has confirmed in play, kept as a page that every development build is checked against before it is delivered. Numbers first, pictures second. Pages of kind session run in one emulator session; journey pages read a journey that runs on every build; image pages check the image's files; gate pages are data checks that run in the gate itself.

pages.title: A carried light (the debug torch, the glass lantern, a candle) is held in the left hand in first and in third person
pages.what: Every carried light sits in the left hand: the torch, the glass lantern, candles and candlesticks, drawn as themselves with their flames, in first person and in third person, with the hands raised.

confirmed.how: seen in game on the v0.0.61 release image: the candle, the pewter candlestick and the glass lantern drawn as themselves in the hand in first person (HELD-LIGHT-ALWAYS-TORCH-61)
the maintainer's report of the regression: every carried light was held in the left hand in first person for many versions, and third person still holds it right

pages.title: In the opening the dock guard walks to his post by the census office door and is not caught in a pier post
pages.what: After the race choice the dock guard walks along the pier to his post beside the census office door, around the posts, and the player walks past him into the office.

confirmed.how: the maintainer's report of the regression: the walk had worked from v0.0.66-dev2 (fixed there, confirmed in play by the opening journey on v0.0.66-dev5 and every journey since)

code.what: the opening's actors and the dock guard's walk

checks: step 1 of the opening journey: the walk up the pier past the dock guard reaches the census office and the papers are taken (and, once the opening worker's check is in, the guard's box never overlaps a solid on his walk)

pages.title: The inventory's key line names the right action for every kind of item
pages.what: The key line under the inventory says equip (or unequip when worn) for weapons, armour, clothing and lights, use for potions and scrolls, read for books, eat for ingredients, and never offers equip on an item that cannot be equipped.

confirmed.how: the maintainer's report of the regression: the equip hint had been fixed before and is missing again on items that can be equipped (EQUIP-ACTION-REGRESSION-62)

pages.title: The cliff racer is drawn whole: wings joined to the body, no holes
pages.what: The cliff racer (and its blighted and diseased kinds, one mesh) is baked whole from its source: every source triangle on shared vertices, no open edge, the whole surface kept.

confirmed.how: the maintainer's report of the regression: the racer had been whole since the v0.0.58 fix (CREATURE-RACER-MESH-SPIKE-58)

pages.image_check: The creature surface check of the image's creature library (tools/creature_surface.py, from the cliff racer repair): the cliff racer's model has its source's 965 triangles on 667 shared vertices, no open edge, and 100 % of the whole model's surface within 0.5 units; then a close-up still in first and third person.
checks: 965 of 965 triangles, 667 vertices, 0 open edges, the whole surface within 0.5 units of its source
